text.en:
MALACAÑAN PALACE
BY THE PRESIDENT OF THE PHILIPPINES
[ EXECUTIVE ORDER NO. 346, July 29, 1959 ]
ADJUSTING THE CLASSIFICATION OF THE MUNICIPALITY OF ALITAGTAG, PROVINCE OF
BATANGAS, AND AMENDING FOR THIS PURPOSE, EXECUTIVE ORDER NO. 333, DATED
WHEREAS, upon verification by the General Auditing Office, it was found out that the average annual
revenue for the fiscal years 1955-58 of the municipality of Alitagtag was P31,779.37; and
WHEREAS, under section 2170 of the Revised Administrative Code, as amended, the municipality of
Alitagtag should-have been re-classified as 2nd class instead of 3rd class;
NOW, THEREFORE, I, CARLOS P. GARCIA, President of the Philippines, by virtue of the powers vested in
me by law, do hereby adjust the re-classification of the municipality of Alitagtag, province of Batangas, to
This classification takes effect as of July 1, 1958.
IN WITNESS WHEREOF, I have hereunto set my hand and caused the seal of the Republic of the Philippines
to be affixed.
Done in the City of Manila, this 29th day of July, in the year of Our Lord, nineteen hundred and fifty-nine,
and of the Independence of the Philippines, the fourteenth.
(Sgd.) CARLOS P. GARCIA
President of the Philippines
By the President:
(Sgd.) JUAN C. PAJO
Executive Secretary
